home.title: Your number for today
home.body: What is safe to spend after bills and goals. Tap it to see how it is worked out.

home.title: Make Home yours
home.body: Reorder, hide or add tiles so Home shows only what you care about.

home.title: Settings and replays
home.body: Backup, capture, privacy and every walkthrough live here.

budget.title: Spent against plan
budget.body: This month at a glance. It updates as card alerts arrive.

budget.title: Categories, your way
budget.body: Swipe through them. Tap Edit to rename, set a budget, or add your own category.

budget.title: Build, import, automate
budget.body: Build a budget from a few answers, import your sheet, or set rules that file things for you.

cards.title: Add a card or account
cards.body: Pick from the catalogue and the card appears exactly as it looks in your wallet.

cards.title: Which card should I use?
cards.body: Tap the bolt before you pay. We rank your cards for that purchase.

cards.title: Cards and accounts
cards.body: Switch between your cards and your bank accounts here.

splits.title: Split an expense
splits.body: Add who paid and who shares it. Settling up is one more tap.

splits.title: Your groups
splits.body: Open a group to see who owes whom, and settle in one go.

wealth.title: Net worth
wealth.body: Everything you own minus everything you owe, in one number.

wealth.title: Add assets and loans
wealth.body: Gold, funds, property, savings, loans. Approximate is fine to start.

categories.title: Add your own category
categories.body: Tap + (or New category below) for your own name, icon and monthly budget.

categories.title: Tap to set a budget
categories.body: Each row opens its budget and icon. Custom ones are marked.

vault.title: What your family would need
vault.body: Tap Add for a policy, a loan, a paper or an investment, and where it is held.

vault.title: People you trust
vault.body: Name someone who can open this if something happens to you.

capture.title: Set up capture once
capture.body: After this, payments arrive on their own. No typing.

plus.title: What Plus adds
plus.body: Core budgeting stays free. Plus adds deeper card intel and AI summaries.
